description: This file contains benchmark tests for Abseil flags, including marshalling, parsing, reflection, and performance measurement of flag retrieval functions using the Google Benchmark library.

classes.name: OptionalInt
classes.description: A wrapper struct for absl::optional<int> with marshalling functions.

classes.name: OptionalString
classes.description: A wrapper struct for absl::optional<std::string> with marshalling functions.

classes.name: UDT
classes.description: A user-defined type with marshalling functions for flags.

classes.name: Accumulator<T>
classes.description: Template struct for accumulating flag values during benchmarks.

methods.description: Converts an OptionalInt, OptionalString, or UDT to string.

methods.name: BM_SingleGetFlag_<T>
